name: What types of garage flooring options are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of garage flooring options are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common garage flooring options include epoxy coatings, polyurea/polyaspartic coatings, and interlocking tiles. Epoxy offers durability and chemical resistance, while polyurea/polyaspartic provides faster cure times and greater flexibility, making it ideal for varying temperatures. Interlocking tiles are a modular solution, easy to install and replace, offering good impact protection. Each option has distinct benefits regarding longevity, appearance, and maintenance requirements, suitable for different garage uses.
